title: Fully Explicit Simplicity — Graph Controller Runtime Operations

checks.name: controller registration has a graph-domain ADT and operation contract
graph builder uses controller registry instead of deleted membership foundation
manifest graph compiler delegates controller action reconciliation to domain operation
graph assembly consumes graph-owned controller entries
runtime graph factory is an explicitly typed frozen operation object
CLI calls typed graph factory interface
public core surface exports typed graph factory
graph path does not import deleted membership foundation

remainingBlockers: manifestGraphCompiler still imports deleted relationalSequence for Sequence folding/projection; migrate to the existing domain-owned Sequence ADT operations without restoring the deleted module.

ServiceGraphBuilder model/service Lookup contracts still depend on upstream collections.ts, which is intentionally empty; preserve that constraint and resolve the owning ADT/interface boundary rather than populating collections.ts.
Other upstream, CLI, manifest and IR consumers still import deleted relation foundation modules; this phase is a bounded graph-controller migration, not a full-workspace cutover.
Full build/test verification requires the project toolchain and dependency installation; no full build is claimed by this structural audit.
